senses.gloss:
दोल m. (-लः)
 1. Swinging.
 2. A festival on the 14th of Phālgun, the
swinging of the juvenile KṚṢṆA.
 m. (-लः-ला or ली)
 1. A litter, a
swinging cot, a dooly.
 2. A swing.
 f. (-ला) The indigo plant.
 E. दुल्
to throw up or toss, to swing, affix अच्; fem. affix टाप् or ङीष् ।

दोलायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
 1. Swinging, being swung.
 2. Doubting,
perplexed, vacillating.
 E. दुल् to swing, causal form, शानच् aff.

दोलिका f. (-का) A swing.
 E. कन् added to दोली ।
